'''Tager'na''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Tager'na lived on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he ran a [[Armor/Legends|light armor]]-selling business located at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Gnarls Outpost|training ground]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]]<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tager'na first appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
